0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings, 1-10 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Portland Trail Blazers, who are 7-3 and riding a one-game win streak, in the Kings' 12th game of the season, and Sacramento is still winless at home at 0-6. The Kings sit 5th in the Pacific and 8.5 games back and 14th in the West, while Portland is 3rd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back and 8th in the West, and the teams have met once this season, with Sacramento losing 128-120 in Sacramento on October 23, after the Kings were swept 0-4 by Portland in 2025-26. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise), and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle).
